scope: the Item-253 half-binomial prefix localized as an incomplete-beta moment on actual ordinary-j=2 phase rows

PROVED.claim: The exact beta identity 2^m K_(d,m)=(2m+d)binom(3m+d,m)I_(m,d) holds, and every prefactor is a p-unit, so H_m=0 modulo p exactly when I_(m,d)=0 modulo p.
PROVED.evidence: report Section 2; 130 portable and 80 independent exact beta checks plus all-row phase replay
PROVED.scope_limit: This localizes but does not evaluate the incomplete moment.

PROVED.claim: The c-moment orbit obeys the endpoint-retaining contiguous recurrence (1.7), and denominator complement gives M_(m+1)(c)=-c^m M_0(c^(-1)) modulo p.
PROVED.evidence: report Sections 3-4; exact derivative proof, 1,650 portable and 1,320 independent endpoint checks, and modular reflection replay
PROVED.scope_limit: The target c=-2 is paired with c=-1/2, not with itself.

PROVED.claim: On the actual phase, the natural reciprocal two-moment coefficient matrix has rank one and its affine endpoint constants are compatible, so this orbit supplies no second condition on H_m or an affine target value.
PROVED.evidence: report equation (1.10), complementary-factor product, and rank-one verification on all 2,440 portable rows
PROVED.scope_limit: This is a no-go only for the reciprocal pair and first-order contiguous orbit; it does not exclude higher jets or independent periods.

PROVED.claim: The first Hasse digit of the characteristic-zero determinant is exactly 2 times the moving harmonic interval sum_(t=0)^m 1/(2m+d+t) modulo p.
PROVED.evidence: report equation (1.11); exact complementary product modulo p^2 and independent replay on 1,153 rows
PROVED.scope_limit: The interval is not a universal unit: it vanishes on the admissible row (p,r,s)=(23,1,3), where the determinant numerator has p-adic valuation two.
